_why: The spec marks `creditCard` and `creditCardHolderInfo` as required in SubscriptionUpdateCreditCardRequestDTO (PUT /v3/subscriptions/{id}/creditCard). Asaas's own reference page for this call says the opposite for a saved card: `creditCardToken` is "a token valid for the subscription's customer; when it is provided, the creditCard and creditCardHolderInfo fields are not required". Only `remoteIp` stays required. While the `required` was in the schema, swapping a subscription to a saved card was refused before the handler ran. The handler keeps requiring both when no token is sent; that error's text was not captured from the sandbox, so it keeps the shape the mock answered before. Same defect as overlay 005, on the subscription side. spec/openapi.json stays untouched so the drift diff against upstream stays clean.
